annotations.text:
Same system as the marketing site, tuned for density: Syne for headings and figures, Instrument Sans for everything readable, Space Mono confined to labels, IDs, coordinates and money.

Three structural changes beyond restyling:

1. Dashboard stats now answer "what is happening to my requests" — open, in the field, spend, median return — instead of mixing poster and worker metrics in one row.

2. Admin is reorganised around the work: dispatch queue and disputes first, money and people below. The assignment step becomes a proper queue table rather than a list of cards.

3. The verification detail screen shows the evidence — photo slots, GPS distance from the filed address, per-check answers — where today it prints the submission as a paragraph of text. This is the screen the product is actually selling.

Copy assumption to confirm.

I carried the site's verification vocabulary into the app: "New request", "My requests", "Assigned to me", "Verifiers". Today the nav still says "Send a Task", "My Tasks", "My Work", "Workers".

The screens work either way — say the word if you would rather keep task language inside the product.
